Date :- 12th January, 2024 Per Court :-

1. The Petitioner is completely misconceived in his submission that page 21 is an
award and page 30 is an e-
statement.
Page 21 is the revised valuation chart for the purposes of arriving at a consent award.
Similarly, page 30 contains the details of such revised valuation.
By no stretch of imagination, it can be termed as an award.

2. The learned AGP places on record the communication dated 12.01.2024, which is marked as "X"
for identification.

According to him, steps would be taken in view of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land *2* 914wp12791o23 Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013, for acquisition and payment of compensation.

3. In view of the above, the learned Advocate for the Petitioner submits that this petition may be disposed off with a direction to the Authorities to follow the procedure strictly as is provided under the 2013 Act.
